_comment: AI-generated building models (Tripo). style is prepended to every prompt. height = target height in metres in the game (one map cell is 2 m).
style: Highly detailed stylized-realistic 3D game asset, isometric strategy game building, hand-painted PBR textures, warm natural materials, single object on a small patch of ground, no text.
